description: This file contains utility functions for managing disk cache directories, including renaming, deleting, and calculating cache sizes, primarily used within Chromium's disk cache implementation.

methods.name: GetPrefixedName
methods.description: Generates a filename with a prefix and index, used for renaming cache directories.

methods.name: GetTempCacheName
methods.description: Finds a temporary cache directory name that does not exist yet.

methods.name: CleanupTemporaryDirectories
methods.description: Deletes old cache directories in the background.

methods.name: MoveDirectoryToTemporaryDirectory
methods.description: Renames a cache directory to a temporary location for cleanup.

methods.name: CleanupDirectoryInternal
methods.description: Renames cache directory and initiates background cleanup of old directories.

methods.name: PreferredCacheSizeInternal
methods.description: Calculates preferred cache size based on available disk space.

methods.name: DeleteCache
methods.description: Deletes cache files or folders at a specified path.

methods.name: CleanupDirectory
methods.description: Asynchronously cleans up a cache directory.

methods.name: CleanupDirectorySync
methods.description: Synchronously cleans up a cache directory.

methods.name: PreferredCacheSize
methods.description: Calculates the preferred cache size based on available space and cache type.
